conflictPrompt: Pull request #{{prNumber}} has merge conflicts with {{baseRef}}. Fetch {{baseRef}}, merge it into {{branch}}, resolve every conflict keeping both sides' intent, run the tests, and commit the merge.
localConflictPrompt:
A merge or rebase in this worktree ({{worktreePath}}) stopped on conflicts.

- Start with git status to see the operation in progress and the unmerged paths.
- Resolve each conflict by reading both sides and the surrounding code; do not take ours or theirs wholesale unless that is clearly right.
- Stage each resolved path and continue the operation (git merge --continue or git rebase --continue) until it completes.
- Do not abort the operation, reset, stash or push.

Reply with the decision for each file and the final git status.

reviewInbox.prompt: You are reviewing pull request #{{prNumber}} — "{{title}}" by {{author}} ({{url}}). The branch {{branch}} is checked out and the diff is pointed at {{baseRef}}. Review it and leave draft comments with `icarus review comment add`.
reviewInbox.rereviewPrompt: You reviewed pull request #{{prNumber}} — "{{title}}" by {{author}} ({{url}}) before, and {{author}} has asked you to look again. The diff is pointed at {{sinceCommit}}, the commit you last reviewed. Say how each change you asked for was answered.
